correctness.rationale: Read the actual RESULT.md proof from the pinned source tree. The total-order comparison word c_i on path edges is arbitrary because the path carries no inequality cycle. Each chosen strong incidence imposes local unary constraints; pairwise inconsistency gives the exact opposite-orientation / offset-one / offset-two graph. Under reversal no incidence vertex is fixed, so admissible two-vertex orbits, with equal barycentric weights, PL-triangulate the geometric fixed locus. Removing the lone terminal inadmissible orbit gives exactly path edges plus odd j-to-j+3 chords of G_m. The vertex-1 neighborhood removes {0,1,2,4}, leaving explicit G_{m-2}, and two-cone union yields suspension. Bases G_1 point and G_2 path3 S^0 give the stated classes. Independently checked explicit graph edge-isomorphism and recurrence for m=3..18; finite tests cannot prove the recurrence without the symbolic bijection.
